packageRules.description: Pin the images the app is built from, as the container repos do. The local dev stack in compose.yml is left as it is.

global.json pins one .NET preview SDK with rollForward disabled. The SDK, the images and the ASP.NET Core preview packages each use their own version scheme, so Renovate can't move them to the same preview together (it once bumped the devcontainer to preview.7 and OpenApi to rc.3 while global.json stayed on preview.6). Version updates wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard and are done by hand in one PR.
Pinning and digest updates of the .NET images keep the same SDK, so they don't need approval.
Marten builds on a specific Npgsql major.
The source generator and its abstractions must stay on the same version.
xUnit and the test runner tooling move together.
A new Postgres major in the dev stack is a data migration, not a routine bump.
